Casting a spell

Follow one spell from a graph entity into a session’s working set. Then cross the ink line and inspect the intended cast without mistaking it for shipped behavior.

Solid ink — shipped, true of tm8 today Ghost ink — designed, not built edge registry + Section 6 verified 2026-08-20
Truth floor

No spell-casting runtime or hook machinery ships today. tm8 can store, equip, and pull a spell. It cannot yet fire a hook or inject a spell prompt into a live PTY.

01Drive the boundary

Play once, step, or scrub. Frames 1–3 stay in solid ink; frames 4–5 deliberately move into ghost ink.

AUTHOR The dashed lane is a design, never a simulation of current behavior.
1 / 5

  1. A spell entity named Review the green build exists at version 3 and is authored in Northlake.
  2. A teammate, task, or work session can point to the spell with an equips edge.
  3. A teammate can pull a pinned spell into a working set; equipped context can ride into a spawn.
  4. GitHub Actions completion as a casting event is a future design, not built today.
  5. The hook firing and the spell prompt materializing in a live PTY are future designs; no runtime or hook machinery ships today.

02The shipped moves

The command catalog and edge registry expose the solid-ink half. Use the toggle to compare real syntax with a real-shaped response.

tm8 — northlakepty
tm8 entity create spell "Review the green build" --space <space-id>
tm8 edge create <teammate-id> equips <spell-id>
tm8 edge create <task-id> equips <spell-id>
tm8 edge create <session-id> equips <spell-id>
tm8 entity pull <spell-id> --pinned-version 3

Edge direction matters.

equips starts at a team_member, task, or work_session and points to the spell. pulled records local adoption by a member or teammate.

entities.create — trimmed, real-shapedjson
{
  "id": "01a09fa1-7a10-7a21-8b32-a1b2c3d4e501",
  "spaceId": "01a09e00-0000-7000-8000-1c2d3e4f5a6b",
  "kind": "spell",
  "title": "Review the green build",
  "version": 1,
  "visibility": "space"
}
Honest gap. There is no cast command to show. There is no current output in which a CI event causes a spell prompt to land in a session.

03Keep the advanced nouns separate

Memory

A memory is a first-class, append-only graph entity. Any entity can remembers it. Borrowing one with --memory changes no graph state.

persona working set→task memories

Keepers

Dispatcher chooses and attaches memory at spawn time. Dreamer gardens it asynchronously, away from the working session’s critical path.

Loop

A loop is an entity. Each run points back with triggered_by; those inbound edges are the loop’s run history.

04The future algebra

spell×loop×hook=session behavior programming

Designed, not built. Spells and loops are graph nouns today. The hook and casting runtime needed to compose them are future machinery.
